name: Lego Micro
author: Stohrm
description: This is version 1.2 and is still a work in progress.  I think I figured out how to put it where the original was; so I guess the first file won't be there for a proper comparison.  Even so, there is a lot yet to be "tweaked", but I hope you enjoy what I've accomplished so far.  In addition, I did try to TAG the various LEGO Mods that I used; but they're not showing.
